context: Tests whether the agent correctly maps pom.xml to the java language parameter, extracts Maven dependency coordinates, and invokes the CLI with the correct JSON array format and reports findings as a markdown table.

checklist.name: java language
checklist.description: Sets language to `java` for Maven packages (not `maven`, `jvm`, or `spring`)

checklist.name: pom.xml extraction
checklist.description: Extracts dependency names and versions from pom.xml (e.g. jackson-databind 2.11.0, log4j 1.2.17)

checklist.name: JSON array format
checklist.description: Constructs a JSON array of `{language, name, version}` objects for the Maven dependencies

checklist.name: npx check command
checklist.description: Passes the JSON array to `npx @meterian/cli check` via stdin pipe

checklist.name: Markdown table
checklist.description: Report contains a markdown table with the required columns: Package, Version, Severity, ID, Safe Versions

checklist.name: Summary line
checklist.description: Report includes a summary line with total vulnerability count and number of clean packages
